definitions.explanation: A style, method, or design that follows Western (European/American) conventions, as opposed to traditional Japanese or Eastern styles.

examples.japanese: {洋式|ようしき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋式|ようしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{造|つく}りになっている。
examples.english: This building is built in Western style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋式|ようしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{様式|ようしき}→様式：05455_youshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: Western lifestyles spread in Japan during the Meiji period.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the phrase {洋式|ようしき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (Western-style toilet, i.e., a sit-down toilet), in contrast to ⟦{和式|わしき}→和式：23138_washiki⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (Japanese-style squat toilet). This distinction is very practical for learners in Japan, as signs in public restrooms often indicate the type available.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋式|ようしき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ — Western-style (sit-down) toilet
- {洋式|ようしき}⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ — Western-style architecture
- {洋式|ようしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ — Western-style room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和式|わしき}→和式：23138_washiki⟧ — Japanese-style (the direct opposite)
- ⟦{様式|ようしき}→様式：05455_youshiki⟧ — style, format (homophone with different kanji; refers to style or form in general)
